character_notes.nagoji: Chin and jaw cleanly shaved, smooth skin, no beard. On the earlobe a tiny flush gold stud with nothing hanging from it.
character_notes.padmini: Her hair is thick and BLACK with no grey at all. Muted earth-toned silk sari, the old Kerala drape with no stitched blouse; a sword with a worn leather-wrapped hilt at her right side.
character_notes.revathi: Deep indigo sari shot with gold, the end over her LEFT shoulder covering the chest, her RIGHT shoulder bare; braid looped with jasmine; a necklace of flat gold coins; gold armlets; a gold anklet; a thin sandalwood line at the hairline; kohl; no tali.
character_notes.ibrahim: His scar runs from the LEFT ear to the jaw, a thin pale line. Nothing on his forehead.
